title: Spatial proximity sequencing maps developmental dynamics in the germinal center.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Found GEO series GSE304749 (public, 6 samples) by searching GEO for 'Sprox-seq'; the paper itself has no open full text. Read the GEO filelist: 3 Visium sections (A1, B1, D1), each with an RNA matrix.mtx (46-60 MB gz), spot positions and images, plus 3 PLA (proximity ligation assay, which counts pairs of proteins sitting next to each other) count matrices (1.6-2.0 MB gz). Opened the A1 PLA matrix: 1,678 protein-pair rows x 3,218 spots, 57.5% zeros, 46 antibody tags including isotype controls (mIgG, HIgG). Opened the A1 features file (38,606 Ensembl genes) and positions (4,992 spots, 3,218 in tissue, which matches the PLA columns).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 32 proteins, 528 pairwise interactions, the light-zone/dark-zone findings and the B cell trajectory come from the abstract and GEO summary. GEO design: A1 and B1 are two regions from one donor and D1 is from a second donor, so 2 donors in total. The B1 and D1 matrices were not opened; their spot counts are unverified.

a1_downloadable.note: Public GEO GSE304749, no login. Checked the FTP listing and downloaded the A1 files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: If the target is the PLA (proximity ligation assay) pair counts per spot, it is a ready matrix (checked in the A1 file). No cell-level or outcome label exists. Germinal-center zones and B cell states would have to be built by clustering.

a3_inputs_present.note: RNA counts per spot (38,606 Ensembl genes) and spot coordinates are present. Checked for A1.

a4_units_stated.note: Raw integer UMI (unique molecular identifier) counts in both modalities; units are implicit but standard.

a5_enough_rows.note: 3,218 spots in A1 (verified); roughly 9,000 across 3 sections (estimated). But the independent unit is the donor: there are 2 donors and 3 tissue sections. Like the scCT-DB case, the big spot count hides n=2 for any claim that a model generalizes.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~0.5 GB (3 RNA mtx of 46-60 MB gz plus 3 PLA matrices of ~2 MB)

a7_counts_match_paper.note: The PLA matrix has 46 tags (32 proteins, some split into A/B probes, plus isotype controls) and 1,678 pairs. That is consistent with 528 pairs among 32 proteins once probe orientation and controls are counted, but I could not reconcile the numbers exactly without the methods section.

a8_label_provenance.note: PLA counts are a direct sequencing measurement and do not come from another model. Interaction 'scores' and cell states in the paper are computed downstream.

existing_models.name: DGAT (dual-graph attention network, Nature Communications 2026)
existing_models.score_and_split: Imputes spatial protein levels from spatial RNA; trained on multi-sample spatial RNA+protein datasets. I did not retrieve its scores.

existing_models.name: SR2P (stacking ensemble, bioRxiv 2026)
existing_models.score_and_split: Predicts spatial protein abundance from gene expression by stacking 11 base learners; scores not retrieved.

existing_models.name: cTP-net (Nature Communications 2020) and SPIDER, zero-shot ensemble (Cell Systems 2024)
existing_models.score_and_split: Single-cell surface-protein imputation from RNA, trained on CITE-seq (a method measuring RNA and surface proteins in the same cell). Scores not retrieved.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell RNA foundation models), applied to spot RNA profiles

integration.partner_dataset: Public 10x Visium CytAssist tonsil gene+protein datasets and tonsil CITE-seq atlases
integration.join_key: Ensembl gene ID / protein marker name
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Can protein-pair proximity in tissue be predicted from RNA alone, so that any Visium tonsil dataset gains an interaction layer?

controls.positive_control: Predicting CD19/CD20 PLA counts from MS4A1/CD19 RNA should succeed, and the B-zone versus T-zone split should be recovered.
controls.negative_control: Isotype-control pairs (mIgG, HIgG) should be unpredictable from RNA, and shuffling spots should reduce performance to the mean.
controls.external_validation: None with matched PLA data. Only the second donor (D1) is available as a held-out section.

honest_claim_h3: Within tonsil sections from 2 donors, spot-level RNA predicts PLA (proximity ligation assay) protein-pair counts to some degree, with no evidence that this holds for other donors or tissues.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the gene activity in each small patch of tonsil tissue to predict which pairs of surface proteins sit next to each other there.
plain_idea.train_on: RNA counts for 38,606 genes in each 55-micron tissue spot: 3,218 spots verified in one section, about 9,000 across 3 sections from 2 donors.
plain_idea.predict: Counts of 1,678 protein-pair proximity signals per spot, measured directly by antibody-DNA proximity ligation followed by sequencing.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: If it worked, ordinary spatial RNA datasets could be given a protein-interaction layer. With 2 donors, though, the result could not be shown to generalize.

more_or_better_data.why: The target (protein-pair proximity, not single-protein abundance) is unusual, but there are only 3 sections and 2 donors. That is far smaller than the multi-dataset training sets used by DGAT and SR2P for protein imputation.

confidence_score.why: With 2 donors, uncertainty across donors cannot be estimated; within-section noise could be estimated only from neighbouring spots.

models_beatable.why: DGAT and SR2P (2025-2026) target single-protein abundance, not pairs, so no direct baseline exists. But they are recent graph and ensemble models, and I did not check their splits.

guaranteed_improvement.why: No other dataset measures the same PLA pairs the same way, so the conditions of same quantity, same assay and same split cannot hold.

ml_idea: Cross-modal regression from spot RNA (optionally scGPT embeddings plus spatial-neighbour features) to PLA pair counts, tested by holding out donor D1. Rejected because it rests on 2 donors.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from file sizes (mtx 46-60 MB gz each) and ~9,000 spots; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Number of donors: GEO design states 2 (A1 and B1 from the same donor, D1 from another). This kills any generalization claim.

verdict_reason: The data are clean and public (GEO GSE304749, verified), but there are only 3 tissue sections from 2 donors. About 9,000 non-independent spots stand in for n=2, the A5 failure in disguise. The closest task, predicting protein from spatial RNA, already has DGAT and SR2P. No outcome label exists beyond the raw count matrices.
